import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[] to;
        int[] flow;
        int[] cap;
        int lastEdge;

        int[][] g;

        boolean[] used;

        MaxFlow() {
            lastEdge = 0;
            g = new int[n][];
            used = new boolean[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            this.to[lastEdge] = to;
            this.flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            this.cap[lastEdge] = cap;
            g[from].add(lastEdge++);

            this.to[lastEdge] = from;
            this.flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            this.cap[lastEdge] = 0;
            g[to].add(lastEdge++);
        }

        boolean dfs(int v, int T, int curFlow) {
            if (v == T) {
                return true;
            }

            used[v] = true;

            for (int idx: g[v]) {
                if (!used[to[idx]] && cap[idx] - flow[idx] >= curFlow &&
                        dfs(to[idx], T, curFlow)) {
                    flow[idx] += curFlow;
                    flow[idx ^ 1] -= curFlow;

                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int getMaxFlow(int S, int T) {
            int curFlow = 1 << 30;
            int resFlow = 0;

            while (curFlow > 0) {
                if (dfs(S, T, curFlow)) {
                    resFlow += curFlow;
                } else {
                    curFlow >>= 1;
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    used[i] = false;
                }
            }

            return resFlow;
        }
    }

    static MaxFlow maxFlow;

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a, b;
    static int[][] dist;
    static boolean[][] used;

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n &&
                0 <= y && y < n &&
                a[x][y] != 'Y' &&
                a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsDeath(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            }
        }

        Queue<int[]> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        queue.add(new int[]{x, y});

        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = queue.poll();

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = cur[0] + dx[k];
                int ty = cur[1] + dy[k];

                if (ok(tx, ty) && dist[tx][ty] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    dist[tx][ty] = dist[cur[0]][cur[1]] + 1;
                    queue.add(new int[]{tx, ty});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void runBFS(int x, int y) {
        Queue<int[]> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[n][n];
        queue.add(new int[]{x, y});
        visited[x][y] = true;

        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = queue.poll();

            if (Character.isDigit(b[cur[0]][cur[1]]) && b[cur[0]][cur[1]] != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, (n * n) + 1 + cur[0] * n + cur[1], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }

            if (dist[cur[0]][cur[1]] >= t) {
                continue;
            }

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = cur[0] + dx[k];
                int ty = cur[1] + dy[k];

                if (ok(tx, ty) && !visited[tx][ty]) {
                    if (dist[tx][ty] > dist[cur[0]][cur[1]] + 1) {
                        queue.add(new int[]{tx, ty});
                        visited[tx][ty] = true;
                        dist[tx][ty] = dist[cur[0]][cur[1]] + 1;
                    } else if (dist[tx][ty] > dist[cur[0]][cur[1]] && Character.isDigit(b[tx][ty]) && b[tx][ty] != '0') {
                        maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, (n * n) + 1 + tx * n + ty, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    }

                    visited[tx][ty] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build() {
        int posi = -1, posj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && posi == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n && posi == -1; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    posi = i;
                    posj = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfsDeath(posi, posj);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(0, i * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i][j]) && b[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(i * n + j + (n * n) + 1, n * n, b[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    runBFS(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int MAXM = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int dx[] = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int dy[] = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int S = MAXN - 2;
    static final int T = MAXN - 1;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastScanner in = new FastScanner();
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        n = in.nextInt();
        t = in.nextInt();

        a = new char[n][];
        b = new char[n][];
        dist = new int[n][n];
        used = new boolean[n][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = in.next().toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b[i] = in.next().toCharArray();
        }

        maxFlow = new MaxFlow();
        build();

        out.println(maxFlow.getMaxFlow(S, T));

        out.close();
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public FastScanner() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        public String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        public double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }

        public String nextLine() {
            String str = "";
            try {
                str = br.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return str;
        }
    }
}
